title: A group rate needs its stated condition
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Total individual trip cost is $395, all expenses included.
Package costs $720 for exactly two travelers sharing; individual bookings cost $460 per traveler. Both rates include all expenses.
Has a lake and walking paths.
Total individual trip cost is $410, all expenses included.

initial.reasons: Copper Marsh fits the solo cost limit.

advice.text: Split the $720 package in half: Jade Hollow is $360 each and fits your budget.

followups.reasons: There is no second traveler, so the applicable Jade Hollow price is $460.
followups.reflection: There is no second traveler, so the applicable Jade Hollow price is $460.
